coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore, hyphen or comb run: the characters' box (first to last character). Text tick box "/ /" or "[ ]": the three characters' box. Drawn rule: its x extent and the 10 pt above it. Drawn box: its rectangle.
how_measured: pdfplumber drawn rules (thin rects) and characters; bordered rows split at their captions; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

third_parties: transfer agent (Transfer Agent Use Only box, page 2)
broker-dealer, financial advisor and branch manager (Section 7, page 6)
custodian or trustee signs the owner line for third-party-administered IRAs (page 9)
signing.kind: Subscription agreement of a REIT (HTML form printed landscape). The owner and joint owner initial each representation (pages 7-8) and sign page 9; the company accepts on page 9 ("By"). The financial advisor and branch manager sign Section 7 (page 6). Direct deposit and automatic investment sections carry their own bank-owner signature cells (pages 4 and 5).
signing.individual_and_entity: only through the section 3 rows: individual/custodian/trustee rows and a separate trust/corporation/partnership row (page 2)
